criteria.title: Versioned WCAG scope and required sets are preserved
criteria.description: The candidate uses the named WCAG 2.0/2.1/2.2 version and level, closes the correct static criterion and conformance-requirement set, and never substitutes another version.

criteria.title: WCAG-EM methodology and sample meaning are preserved
criteria.description: The candidate evaluates product scope, exploration, structured/random sampling, complete processes, comparisons, and report closure without inventing sample identity or completeness.

criteria.title: Procedure and evidence roles are correct
criteria.description: The candidate respects finite machine probes, semantic/manual/AT/external applicability and evidence contracts, and never turns tool limits into conformance results.

criteria.title: Handoff, freshness, and report contracts are preserved
criteria.description: The candidate uses qa-workflow handoff ownership, freshness and CAS lifecycle, resume guards, report/claim/statement/EARL conditions, and does not make unsupported claims.
